description: A React component for displaying feature discovery information in the Mattermost admin console, including trial/license status, contact sales, and start trial options.

classes.name: FeatureDiscovery
classes.description: A React component that manages and displays feature discovery, trial status, and licensing information in the Mattermost admin console.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches previous trial license info when component mounts.

methods.name: contactSalesFunc
methods.description: Prepares and navigates to the contact sales form with customer info.

methods.name: renderPostTrialCta
methods.description: Renders call-to-action buttons for contacting sales or learning more after trial.

methods.name: renderStartTrial
methods.description: Renders start trial button and legal terms, or contact sales button if cloud.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method handling different states: loading, trial, license updates, and main display.
